📚 Hard vocab word #25: INIMICAL

inimical (adjective): harmful or hostile.

✅ In a sentence: Extreme cold is inimical to most plant life.
✅ Similar: hostile, harmful, adverse
✅ Remember it: Related to "enemy" (Latin inimicus).
